description: Browser-based AI companion with 2D animated talking avatar, voice I/O, and persistent memory

features.name: Project Setup & Dev Server
features.description: Project scaffolding with client (React+Vite) and server (Node/Express) running
steps: Verify the app loads without errors
Check browser console has no critical errors
Verify the page title is 'Digital Human Companion'

features.name: Backend Health Check
features.description: Express server running with /api/health endpoint returning 200
steps: Verify server name and version fields present

features.name: Main Layout Structure
features.description: Header bar, avatar viewport, transcript panel, and text input bar rendered correctly
steps: Verify header with app title 'Digital Human Companion' is visible
Verify avatar viewport area is visible in center
Verify transcript panel exists below avatar
Verify text input bar is at the bottom

features.name: Dark Mode Toggle
features.description: Theme toggle button switches between light and dark mode
steps: Locate the moon/sun icon in the header
Click it to toggle dark mode
Verify background color changes to dark
Click again to return to light mode

features.name: Responsive Layout - Mobile
features.description: Layout adapts correctly at mobile viewport sizes
steps: Verify no overflow or broken layout

features.name: Avatar Canvas Renders
features.description: 2D avatar canvas renders with a face portrait visible
steps: Verify a canvas element is present in the avatar viewport
Verify the avatar face is rendered (not blank canvas)

features.name: Avatar Idle Animations
features.description: Avatar has idle animations: blinking eyes and subtle breathing movement
steps: Verify the eyes blink at least once
Verify subtle breathing/movement animation is visible

features.name: Avatar State - Listening
features.description: Avatar transitions to 'Listening' state visually when user is speaking
steps: Click the microphone button to enable voice input

features.name: Avatar State - Thinking
features.description: Avatar shows 'Thinking' state while Claude is generating a response
steps: Type a message in the text input and send

features.name: Avatar State - Speaking with Lip-Sync
features.description: Avatar shows speaking state with lip movements synchronized to audio
steps: Wait for avatar to start speaking
Verify avatar mouth moves in sync with audio

features.name: Text Message Send - Enter Key
features.description: User can type a message and send with Enter key

features.name: Text Message Send - Button Click
features.description: User can send message by clicking the send button
steps: Type 'Tell me a short story' in the text input

features.name: Empty Message Prevention
features.description: Sending empty message is prevented

features.name: Claude API Response
features.description: Claude API returns a response to user messages
steps: Verify response appears in transcript within 10 seconds
Take screenshot of transcript with response

features.name: Streaming Response Display
features.description: Claude's response streams token-by-token in the transcript
steps: Send a message asking for a paragraph-length response
Verify text appears progressively in the transcript (streaming, not all at once)

features.name: Text-to-Speech Plays
features.description: Avatar speaks the response using TTS
steps: Send a short message like 'Say hello'
Verify audio plays with avatar's voice
Verify avatar mouth moves during audio

features.name: Audio Playback Controls - Stop
features.description: User can stop avatar mid-speech with stop button
steps: Send a message that generates a long response
While avatar is speaking, locate the stop button
Verify avatar returns to idle state

features.name: Microphone Permission Request
features.description: Clicking mic button requests browser microphone permission
steps: Verify browser shows or has shown microphone permission dialog

features.name: Voice Activity Detection
features.description: VAD detects when user starts and stops speaking
steps: Speak a sentence into the microphone
Verify indicator changes when speech ends

features.name: Speech-to-Text Transcription
features.description: Spoken words are transcribed and sent to Claude
steps: Say 'What is the capital of France?'
Verify transcription appears in transcript panel

features.name: Microphone Toggle Off
features.description: User can disable microphone input
steps: Click mic button again to disable
Verify mic icon shows as muted/off
Verify speaking does not trigger listening state

features.name: Barge-In Interrupt
features.description: User can interrupt avatar mid-speech by speaking
steps: Send a long message to get extended response
While avatar is speaking, speak into microphone
Verify avatar transitions to Listening state
Verify audio fades out smoothly (not abrupt cut)

features.name: Stop Button Interrupt
features.description: Stop button appears during Speaking state and stops playback
steps: Send a message that generates a long response
Verify send button changes to stop button during Speaking state
Verify UI returns to ready state

features.name: Post-Interrupt Recovery
features.description: After interrupt, user can immediately send another message
steps: Send long message, wait for speaking to start
Verify Claude responds to the new message

features.name: Transcript Shows User Messages
features.description: User messages appear in the transcript panel
steps: Verify 'Hello world test' appears in transcript panel
Verify it is styled as a user message (right-aligned or labeled 'You')

features.name: Transcript Shows Assistant Messages
features.description: Claude's responses appear in the transcript panel
steps: Send a message and wait for response
Verify Claude's response appears in transcript
Verify it is styled as assistant message (left-aligned or labeled with avatar name)

features.name: Transcript Scrolls to Latest
features.description: Transcript auto-scrolls to show latest messages
steps: Verify transcript always shows latest message
Verify older messages can be scrolled to manually

features.name: Transcript Collapse Toggle
features.description: Transcript panel can be collapsed and expanded
steps: Locate the transcript panel collapse button

features.name: State Indicator - Idle
features.description: State indicator shows correct idle state text
steps: Verify state indicator shows 'Ready' or no indicator when idle

features.name: State Indicator - All States
features.description: State indicator correctly shows Listening, Thinking, Speaking states with correct colors
steps: Enable mic, speak - verify blue 'Listening...' indicator
Send text message - verify amber 'Thinking...' indicator
Wait for response - verify green 'Speaking...' indicator

features.name: Messages Saved to Database
features.description: Conversation messages are persisted in SQLite database
steps: Verify conversation is saved (check via API at /api/conversations)

features.name: Conversation History Loads on Reload
features.description: Previous conversation loads when page is refreshed
steps: Send a distinctive message like 'Remember this unique message 12345'
Verify the previous messages appear in transcript

features.name: New Conversation Creation
features.description: User can start a new conversation
steps: Send a message and get a response
Click 'New Conversation' button (in sidebar or header)
Send a new message to confirm it works

features.name: Sidebar Opens with History
features.description: Hamburger menu opens sidebar with conversation history list

features.name: Load Previous Conversation
features.description: Clicking a past conversation loads its messages
steps: Verify its messages load in the transcript

features.name: Auto-Generated Conversation Title
features.description: Conversations get auto-generated titles based on first exchange
steps: Start a new conversation about 'Python programming'
Verify conversation has a descriptive title (not 'Untitled')

features.name: Delete Conversation
features.description: User can delete a conversation from history
steps: Find the delete button for a conversation

features.name: Settings Panel Opens
features.description: Settings gear icon opens the settings panel
steps: Click the gear icon in the header

features.name: Volume Control
features.description: Volume slider adjusts TTS playback volume

features.name: Show/Hide Transcript Toggle
features.description: Settings toggle controls transcript panel visibility

features.name: Clear Conversation History
features.description: Settings has 'Clear all history' button that removes all conversations

features.name: TTS Fallback Mode
features.description: When TTS service unavailable, app falls back to browser speech or text-only mode
steps: If ElevenLabs is unavailable, verify a fallback TTS or text-only mode activates
Verify a user-facing message explains voice is unavailable
Verify conversation still works in text mode

features.name: Microphone Permission Denied
features.description: Clear message shown when mic permission is denied
steps: If/when permission denied, verify clear error message appears
Verify app degrades gracefully to text-only

features.name: Claude API Error Recovery
features.description: If Claude API fails, user sees error with retry option
steps: Send a message when API key is invalid or service is down
Verify error message appears in UI
Verify error is not just a console error

features.name: Default Persona 'Nova' Active
features.description: Default persona 'Nova' is active with correct name and personality
steps: Verify avatar is labeled or titled 'Nova' somewhere in the UI
Verify response reflects Nova's warm, conversational personality
Verify short, natural-sounding sentences in response

features.name: System Prompt Shapes Responses
features.description: Claude uses the companion persona system prompt
steps: Verify response identifies as Nova (not Claude)

features.name: Conversation Context Maintained
features.description: Claude remembers earlier messages in the same conversation

features.name: Loading State on App Start
features.description: App shows a loading state while initializing
steps: Verify a loading indicator or animation shows briefly
Verify app transitions smoothly to ready state

features.name: No White-on-White or Invisible Text
features.description: All text has sufficient contrast in both light and dark modes
steps: Check all visible text has good contrast
Toggle dark mode and check again

features.name: Hover States on Interactive Elements
features.description: Buttons and interactive elements show hover states
steps: Verify each shows a visible hover effect

features.name: GET /api/models Endpoint
features.description: Server exposes GET /api/models returning the model registry with Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus entries including display_name, tier, latency_profile, and cost fields
steps: Verify JSON response contains a 'models' array
Verify array includes entries for haiku, sonnet, and opus families
Verify each entry has id, display_name, tier, latency_profile, cost_per_1k_input, cost_per_1k_output fields
Verify a 'background_task_model' field is present pointing to Haiku

features.name: ModelPicker Dropdown in Settings
features.description: Settings panel contains a ModelPicker dropdown listing Haiku (Fast & Snappy), Sonnet (Balanced), and Opus (Deep Thinker) with tier/cost/speed tradeoff labels
steps: Open the settings panel via the gear icon
Verify it lists at least three options: Haiku, Sonnet, Opus
Verify each option shows tier and speed indicators
Take screenshot of the dropdown open

features.name: Model Indicator Badge on Avatar Viewport
features.description: A colored dot badge in the avatar viewport corner shows the active model tier: blue=Haiku (fast), green=Sonnet (balanced), amber=Opus (powerful)
steps: Verify a small colored dot badge is visible in the avatar viewport corner
Default model (Sonnet) should show a green dot
Switch model to Haiku via settings; verify badge turns blue
Switch model to Opus; verify badge turns amber
Take screenshot of each badge state

features.name: Per-Model Thinking Timeout
features.description: Avatar 'Thinking' state stays alive without error for model-specific durations: Haiku 3s, Sonnet 5s, Opus 8s
steps: Switch to Haiku and send a message; verify no error appears before 3 seconds of thinking
Switch to Opus and send a complex message; verify 'Thinking...' indicator persists for at least 7 seconds without triggering an error state
Verify the error state only appears after the model's timeout threshold is exceeded

features.name: WebSocket model_switch Message (Client → Server)
features.description: Client sends a model_switch WebSocket message with model_id and scope when user selects a new model
steps: Open browser DevTools → Network → WS tab
Open settings and change the active model
Verify a WebSocket message of type 'model_switch' is sent with model_id and scope fields
Verify the message is sent before the next conversation turn

features.name: WebSocket model_switched ACK (Server → Client)
features.description: Server sends a model_switched ACK WebSocket message after processing a model_switch request; client updates the UI badge
steps: Open browser DevTools → Network → WS tab
Verify server sends a 'model_switched' message with model_id, display_name, and tier
Verify the model badge in the avatar viewport updates immediately after the ACK

features.name: Mid-Conversation Model Switch — New Messages Use New Model
features.description: Switching model mid-conversation applies to the very next message without restarting the conversation; prior messages are unaffected
steps: Send two messages using default Sonnet model
Open settings and switch to Opus
Verify the third assistant response is generated by Opus (check model badge or transcript badge)
Verify the first two responses show Sonnet (or no badge if default)
Verify full conversation context is preserved across the switch

features.name: Model Switch Scope 'all_new_conversations' Persists to Settings DB
features.description: Selecting scope 'all new conversations' when switching model persists the new default to the settings table and survives a server restart
steps: Open settings, select Opus with scope 'all new conversations'
Verify the new conversation uses Opus by default (model badge shows amber)
Verify via GET /api/settings that the default model is persisted

features.name: DB Schema: model_id on Messages, active_model on Conversations
features.description: The messages table has a model_id column recording which model generated each assistant turn; conversations table has an active_model column
steps: Send several messages switching models mid-conversation
Query GET /api/conversations/:id to retrieve conversation with messages
Verify each assistant message has a model_id field
Verify messages sent after a model switch have the new model_id
Verify the conversation object has an active_model field reflecting the current model

features.name: Background Task Model Always Pinned to Haiku
features.description: Auto-title generation and periodic conversation summaries always use Haiku regardless of the user's active model
steps: Start a new conversation and send a few messages
Wait for the conversation to get an auto-generated title
Verify the title was generated (it appears in the sidebar)
Verify server logs show Haiku was used for the title generation request, not Opus

features.name: Transcript Model Badge on Non-Default Model Turns
features.description: Assistant turns generated by a non-default model display a small model badge (e.g. 'Opus') next to the message in the transcript
steps: Send a message using default Sonnet (no badge expected)
Switch to Opus and send another message
Verify the Opus assistant response shows a model badge in the transcript
Verify the Sonnet response has no badge (or a 'default' label)
Take screenshot showing both messages with and without badge

features.name: Active Model Dropdown in Settings
features.description: Settings panel AI section has an 'Active model' dropdown that shows the current model and allows switching
steps: Verify an 'Active model' dropdown is present showing the current model
Change the selection and verify the UI reflects the new model

features.name: Model Switching Scope Toggle in Settings
features.description: Settings AI section has a 'Model switching scope' toggle with options 'This conversation' and 'All new conversations'
steps: Verify it offers at least two options: 'This conversation' and 'All new conversations'
Toggle between them and verify selection is reflected

features.name: Show Model Indicator Toggle in Settings
features.description: Settings AI section has a 'Show model indicator in UI' toggle that controls visibility of the model badge on the avatar viewport
steps: Verify model badge disappears from avatar viewport

features.name: TTS Voice Selection Dropdown
features.description: Settings Voice section has a dropdown to select the TTS voice from available provider voices
steps: Locate the Voice section and the voice selection dropdown
Verify at least one voice option is listed
Send a message and verify TTS uses the newly selected voice

features.name: Speech Rate Slider
features.description: Settings Voice section has a speech rate slider ranging from 0.5x to 2.0x that adjusts TTS playback speed
steps: Verify its range is 0.5x to 2.0x with default 1.0x
Send a message and verify TTS plays noticeably faster
Drag to 0.75x and verify slower playback

features.name: Avatar Character Selector
features.description: Settings Avatar section has a character selector showing available personas the user can switch between
steps: Locate the Avatar section and character selector
Verify at least the default 'Nova' persona is listed
Verify the selector is interactive (even if only one option exists for v1)

features.name: Idle Animation Intensity Slider
features.description: Settings Avatar section has an idle animation intensity slider ranging from subtle to lively
steps: Locate the idle animation intensity slider in the Avatar section
Verify it has at least three positions (subtle, medium, lively)
Drag to minimum and verify avatar animations visibly slow down or reduce
Drag to maximum and verify more pronounced idle movement

features.name: Default Input Mode Toggle (Voice / Text)
features.description: Settings Input section has a toggle to set voice or text as the default input mode on app load
steps: Open settings and set default input mode to 'Text'
Verify app opens in text-input mode (mic not active)
Reload and verify mic activates by default

features.name: Push-to-Talk vs Always-On Toggle
features.description: Settings Input section has a toggle to switch between push-to-talk and always-on microphone modes
steps: Open settings and enable push-to-talk mode
Verify mic only captures audio while a button is held down
Verify mic is continuously active and uses VAD for turn detection

features.name: Caption Font Size Slider
features.description: Settings Display section has a caption font size slider with at least small/medium/large options
steps: Locate the caption font size slider in the Display section
Verify transcript text renders at a larger size
Drag to small and verify text shrinks

features.name: Response Style Toggle (Verbose / Concise)
features.description: Settings AI section has a response style toggle that influences Claude's response length via system prompt
steps: Open settings and set response style to 'Verbose'
Send a message and note response length
Switch to 'Concise' and send the same message
Verify the concise response is noticeably shorter

features.name: Store Conversation History Toggle
features.description: Settings Privacy section has a toggle to enable/disable persisting conversation history to the database
steps: Open settings and toggle 'Store conversation history' to off
Verify no previous messages appear in transcript or sidebar
Re-enable the toggle and verify subsequent conversations are saved

features.name: POST /api/chat/stream Endpoint
features.description: POST /api/chat/stream accepts a user message and conversation_id, streams Claude's response as SSE with text chunks
steps: Send a POST request to http://localhost:3000/api/chat/stream with JSON body containing text and conversation_id
Verify the response is a Server-Sent Events stream (Content-Type: text/event-stream)
Verify a final event signals completion

features.name: POST /api/chat/interrupt Endpoint
features.description: POST /api/chat/interrupt accepts a generation_id and signals the server to abort the current Claude stream and discard queued TTS chunks
steps: Start a streaming response via POST /api/chat/stream
While streaming, POST to /api/chat/interrupt with the active generation_id
Verify the stream stops (no more SSE events received)
Verify the server responds with 200 OK
Verify subsequent messages start a new generation successfully

features.name: GET /api/personas Endpoint
features.description: GET /api/personas returns the list of available personas with id, name, voice_id, and avatar_assets fields
steps: Verify JSON response contains a personas array
Verify at least one entry (the default Nova persona) is present
Verify each entry has id, name, voice_id, and avatar_assets fields
Verify the default persona is marked or is the first entry

features.name: GET /api/settings Endpoint
features.description: GET /api/settings returns the current user settings as a JSON object
steps: Verify JSON response with user settings
Verify settings include at least volume, theme, show_transcript, and active_model fields
Verify default values are sensible (volume 80, theme auto, etc.)

features.name: PUT /api/settings Endpoint
features.description: PUT /api/settings accepts updated settings and persists them to the database
steps: Send PUT request to http://localhost:3000/api/settings with updated volume: 50
Send GET /api/settings and verify volume is now 50
Send GET /api/settings again and verify volume is still 50

features.name: Claude API Rate Limit (429) Recovery
features.description: When Claude returns a 429 rate limit response, the app shows 'Taking a moment...' and auto-retries with backoff
steps: Simulate or trigger a Claude 429 response (via server config or network intercept)
Verify the avatar shows a patient expression
Verify the UI displays a 'Taking a moment...' message (not a hard error)
Verify the app automatically retries and eventually succeeds
Take screenshot of the waiting state

features.name: TTS Audio Gap Handling
features.description: When a gap occurs between TTS audio chunks, the avatar pauses naturally (closes mouth, maintains eye contact) rather than freezing; 200ms pre-buffer prevents most gaps
steps: Send a message that generates a multi-sentence response
Observe the avatar between sentence chunks
Verify no jarring freeze or abrupt state change between chunks
Verify avatar closes mouth naturally during brief gaps

features.name: Browser Tab Backgrounded — Pause Rendering
features.description: When the browser tab is hidden, avatar canvas rendering pauses to save CPU; audio continues; rendering resumes when tab is foregrounded
steps: Verify audio continues playing in the background
Switch back to the app tab
Verify no errors in the console

features.name: WebSocket Disconnect Auto-Reconnect
features.description: When the WebSocket connection drops, the client automatically attempts to reconnect with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s, max 30s) and shows a 'Reconnecting...' indicator
steps: Kill and restart the backend server to force a WebSocket disconnect
Verify a 'Reconnecting...' indicator appears in the UI
Verify the client reconnects automatically within 30 seconds
Verify conversation continues normally after reconnection
Take screenshot of the reconnecting state

features.name: Audio Context Suspended — Click to Enable Audio
features.description: When AudioContext is suspended due to browser autoplay policy, the app shows a 'Click to enable audio' button and resumes on click
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:5173 without any prior interaction
If AudioContext is suspended, verify a 'Click to enable audio' prompt appears
Verify audio context resumes and TTS plays normally
Verify the prompt disappears after enabling

features.name: STT Service Down Fallback
features.description: When the STT (Deepgram) service is unavailable, the app falls back to text input and shows 'Voice input temporarily unavailable'
steps: Simulate STT service unavailability (invalid API key or network block)
Verify a message 'Voice input temporarily unavailable' appears
Verify text input still works normally
Verify no unhandled errors in console

features.name: Generation ID Stale Audio Prevention
features.description: Each request gets a unique generation_id; after an interrupt, audio/text with old generation_id is discarded and never played
steps: Send a long message to start a response
While audio is playing, interrupt by clicking stop
Verify no audio from the interrupted response plays after the interrupt
Send a new message and verify only the new response audio plays
Verify no 'ghost' audio from the old generation appears

features.name: Rolling Window Context — Last 20 Messages Sent in Full
features.description: When a conversation exceeds 20 messages, only the last 20 are sent in full to Claude; older messages are represented by the summary
steps: Send 25+ messages in a single conversation
On a later message, verify Claude still responds coherently
Verify via server logs or network inspect that the API call does not send all 25+ messages verbatim
Verify the oldest messages are replaced with a summary in the context

features.name: Periodic Conversation Summary Generation
features.description: When a conversation exceeds ~50 messages, the server generates a summary of the oldest batch using Haiku in the background and stores it in the conversations.summary column
steps: Wait a few seconds for background processing
Verify the 'summary' field is populated with a non-empty text summary
Verify the summary was generated by the background_task_model (Haiku)

features.name: Surprised Expression State
features.description: Avatar displays a 'Surprised' expression with wide eyes and raised eyebrows when Claude's output contains an exclamation or unexpected input is detected
steps: Send a message designed to elicit an enthusiastic exclamation response
Observe the avatar while the response plays
Verify the avatar briefly shows wide eyes and raised eyebrows (surprised expression)
Take screenshot of the surprised state

features.name: Empathetic Expression State
features.description: Avatar displays an 'Empathetic' expression with soft eyes and a slight closed-mouth smile when Claude uses empathetic keywords like 'sorry', 'I understand', 'that must be'
steps: Send a message about a personal or emotional topic (e.g., 'I'm feeling stressed today')
Verify avatar shows softened eyes and slight empathetic smile
Take screenshot of the empathetic state

features.name: Sentiment-Based Expression Triggering
features.description: Avatar expressions are triggered by keyword matching on Claude's output: sorry/understand → Empathetic, great!/excellent → Positive, exclamations → Surprised
steps: Send messages that will elicit responses with 'sorry' or 'I understand' — verify Empathetic expression
Send messages that elicit 'great!' or 'excellent' responses — verify Positive/engaged expression
Verify default speaking state is Neutral when no sentiment keywords are detected
Verify expressions transition smoothly (no abrupt snapping)

features.name: State Indicator — Interrupted State
features.description: When a barge-in interrupt occurs, the UI briefly flashes an 'Interrupted' state indicator before transitioning to 'Listening...' in blue
steps: Start a long response and interrupt it by speaking
Verify a brief visual flash of interrupted state occurs
Verify state indicator quickly transitions to blue 'Listening...'

features.name: State Indicator — Error State
features.description: When an error occurs (Claude API fail, TTS fail), the state indicator shows a red error message and the avatar shows a confused/concerned expression
steps: Trigger an API error (e.g., invalid API key or network block)
Verify state indicator turns red with an error message
Verify avatar shows a concerned or confused expression
Verify a retry option or dismiss button is visible
Take screenshot of the error state

features.name: State Indicator — Connecting State
features.description: While the WebSocket connection is being established or re-established, the state indicator shows gray 'Connecting...' with a spinner
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:5173 with backend not yet running
Observe the state indicator during the connection establishment
Verify it disappears once connected and transitions to Idle/Ready

features.name: Partial Interrupted Response Stored in DB
features.description: When a response is interrupted, the partial text actually spoken is stored in the messages table with was_interrupted=1 and interrupted_at_char set to the character position
steps: Send a message and interrupt the avatar mid-speech
Verify the interrupted assistant message has was_interrupted set to true/1
Verify interrupted_at_char is set to a non-zero value indicating where it was cut off
Verify the stored content matches what was actually spoken (not the full generation)

features.name: Audio Fade-Out on Interrupt (100ms)
features.description: When interrupted, TTS audio fades out over ~100ms rather than cutting abruptly
steps: Send a long message and interrupt by speaking
Verify audio does not cut off abruptly — there is a brief audible fade-out
Verify the total stop time is approximately 100-120ms
Repeat the test using the stop button and verify same smooth fade

features.name: Empty Transcript After Interrupt — Recovery
features.description: If the user interrupts but doesn't say anything (empty transcript), the avatar either resumes the previous response or says 'Sorry, did you want to say something?'
steps: Make a brief noise to trigger VAD but say nothing
Verify the avatar handles the empty transcript gracefully
Verify it either resumes the prior response or asks if the user wanted to say something

features.name: Interrupt Rate Limiting (Min 1s Between Interrupts)
features.description: Rapid successive interrupts are rate-limited to a minimum of 1 second between interrupt events to prevent thrashing
steps: Trigger rapid interrupts (speak, stop, speak again within <1s)
Verify the system does not thrash or enter an error state
Verify at most one interrupt is processed per second
Verify conversation recovers cleanly after rapid interrupts

features.name: Live Captions Synchronized with Audio During Speaking
features.description: During the Speaking state, transcript text appears word-by-word synchronized with TTS audio playback (not at Claude generation speed)
steps: Send a message and wait for the Speaking state
Observe the transcript panel during audio playback
Verify words appear progressively as the avatar speaks them, not all at once
Verify the caption timing matches the audio (words appear when spoken, not earlier)

features.name: Pre-Warm TTS WebSocket Connection
features.description: The TTS WebSocket connection is established at app startup and kept open, not reconnected per request, reducing per-turn latency by ~200ms
steps: Open browser DevTools → Network → WS tab
Verify a WebSocket connection to the TTS endpoint is established on page load
Send a message and verify the TTS WebSocket does not reconnect — the existing connection is reused
Send a second message and confirm the same connection is still in use

features.name: Gapless Audio Chunk Overlap
features.description: TTS audio for sentence N+1 begins synthesizing before sentence N finishes playing, eliminating audible gaps between sentences
steps: Send a message that produces a multi-sentence response (3+ sentences)
Listen to the avatar's speech carefully
Verify there are no audible pauses or gaps between sentences
Verify playback is continuous and natural-sounding
Check network tab to confirm TTS requests for subsequent sentences begin before prior audio finishes
